commonPlan.busy: Shared DeleteButton lazily mounts one original confirmation or one CmsBusyDialog for the actual awaited action; synchronous row+global in-flight fences. Read-route loading boundary uses shared brand overlay.
commonPlan.deleteIntent: After original current authorization, source hash/version and full deletion qualification checks in the same Serializable transaction, reuse only exact actor/entity/DELETE/DRAFT/baseHash/payload/title.
